Retarder cluster domain proof: the dispatcher chain cm848_processTimingDispatcher (0x4218c) ends in the ERC1 request source code / percent (cm848_buildPgn61440ElectronicRetarderController1Message reads engine_retarder_request_source_code and engine_retarder_request_percent) and logical output 11 (cm848_setLogicalOutputRequest(11), the only set of outputs 11-15; 12-15 are only cleared at init). Fault bits 41 / 42, which zero engine_retarder_selection_percent_fault_masked, decode (ROM 0x5985a slot -> obd_dtc_code_table 0x5b57c) to P0478 / P0477 = exhaust pressure control valve high / low, so the retarder here is most likely an exhaust brake. Switch decode (switch n = byte n/8 bit n%8): [1] mask 8 = switch 11 = brake switch, [1] mask 0x80 = switch 15 = clutch switch (firmware/CLAUDE.md), [1] mask 0x10 = switch 12 = the wired retarder selector.

plate_comment: Evaluates the engine retarder (exhaust brake) enable conditions once per pass and sets engine_retarder_enable_state: 0 = not wanted or exit condition, 1 = wanted but held off by the pedal, clutch or service brake conditions, 2 = enabled (then engine_retarder_limit_percent restarts at 101 = no limit). It uses the service brake switch with a release delay (service_brake_delayed_active_flag), the torque converter lockup state (tc_lockup_disengage_state), oil temperature, engine speed, boost, fuel demand and governor mode thresholds; it also keeps the arbitrated request of the two previous passes (was cm848_processProtectionSystemBit3).
evidence: Read in full (140 lines). Enter / exit flags are built from oil temperature vs engine speed thresholds, boost below a limit, fuel demand at its minimum, lockup state; the state 0 / 1 / 2 assignment follows (S = arbitrated request nonzero, E / X = enter / exit flag, V = driver conditions): 0 for (not S, not E) or (S, X); 1 for (not S, E, not V) or (S, not X, driver inhibit); otherwise 2 with governor_load_percent_min = 101. Called as step 1 of cm848_processTimingDispatcher.

plate_comment: Calculates the operator engine retarder selection percent engine_retarder_selection_percent: 100 or 0 from the wired retarder switch (switch_input_state_bits[1] mask 16), or the J1939 EBC1 retarder selection j1939_engine_retarder_selection_percent when fault_feature_config_flags bit 0 is set, and 100 while the road speed limit is active with operating_mode_flags_cal bit 0 set. engine_retarder_selection_percent_fault_masked is the same value forced to 0 while fault bit 41 or 42 (P0478 / P0477) is detected and engine_feature_enable_flags_cal bit 0x4000 is set; the ERC1 builder uses it for the brake assist bits, and cm848_j1939BuildEngineControlByte sends the percent as EBC1 SPN 973 (was cm848_processProtectionSystemBit4).
evidence: Read in full (24 lines). Output words engine_retarder_selection_percent (read by cm848_applyMinimumProtectionLimit and cm848_j1939BuildEngineControlByte, byte 5 = percent x 5 / 2 = 0.4 percent per bit = SPN 973 Engine Retarder Selection, j1939 DB) and _fault_masked (read by the ERC1 builder). Called from cm848_periodicTaskGroup27_calibration9 (the previous wave named both words; lead confirmed).

plate_comment: Lowers the engine retarder percent limit engine_retarder_limit_percent to the operator selection engine_retarder_selection_percent when that is smaller and records limit source code 3 (operator selection, ERC1 retarder torque mode 1) in engine_retarder_limit_source_code. Step 3 of cm848_processEngineRetarderRequest (was cm848_applyMinimumProtectionLimit).
evidence: Body is 4 lines: if (selection < limit) { limit = selection; code = 3 }. The source code is mapped to ERC1 SPN 900 = 1 (operator selection) in the ERC1 builder (code 3 -> 1).

plate_comment: Applies the TSC1 retarder request recorded by cm848_processEngineRetarderTsc1Request: override control mode 2 (torque control) sets engine_retarder_tsc1_request_percent and engine_retarder_tsc1_request_source_code 1, mode 3 (torque limit) lowers engine_retarder_limit_percent to engine_retarder_torque_limit_percent with limit source code 4, and mode 0 (or no request) clears it; the requesting device index goes to engine_retarder_request_source_index. engine_retarder_internal_override_control_mode, never set in this build, can force the same three cases (was cm848_processGovernorErrorState).
evidence: Read in full (22 lines): reads engine_retarder_override_control_mode / _torque_request_percent / _torque_limit_percent / _controlling_source_index, all written by cm848_processEngineRetarderTsc1Request (the TSC1 handler for the retarder source address). Step 4 of the dispatcher.

plate_comment: Selects the final engine retarder request percent engine_retarder_arbitrated_request_percent and its source code engine_retarder_request_source_code (ERC1 SPN 900 mapping): 0 when the enable state is 0, or 1 with no TSC1 request; with enable state 2 and no TSC1 request the smallest limit engine_retarder_limit_percent and its limit source code; with a TSC1 torque request that request and its code. Skipped while engine_retarder_request_arbitration_inhibit_flag (constant 0 in this build) is set (was cm848_processTemperatureCompensationMode).
evidence: Read in full (27 lines); the three assignments of governor_speed_setpoint / engine_retarder_request_source_code follow fuel_correction_active_flag (0 / 1 / 2) and fuel_correction_state (6 = no TSC1 request, 1 = TSC1 torque request). temp_compensation_active_flag has 1 read here and 1 write (0) in the init: the arbitration always runs.

plate_comment: Sets engine_retarder_active_flag (1 while an arbitrated request exists unless the road speed limit is active, 0 when none), which the transmission lockup / overdrive logic, the wastegate duty request and the cold start loop read. While the transmission reports shift in process (ETC1 SPN 574), engine_retarder_request_shift_hold_flag freezes the request percent and the active flag for up to engine_retarder_shift_hold_passes passes; after the retarder output is released, engine_retarder_release_pending_flag clears the active flag after engine_retarder_release_passes passes. The engine speed dependent engage delay chain at the top writes the hold flag, but it is cleared unconditionally before the shift block, so that chain has no effect (was cm848_processTemperatureTrim).
evidence: Read in full (105 lines) and disassembled: fuel_correction_trigger_flag (0x40a364) stores at 0x41e40 / 0x41e74 (chain), a load at 0x41ea0 and a store at 0x41eb0 (the unconditional clear), then stores at 0x41eec / 0x41ef8 (shift block) and a load at 0x41f5c. fuel_mode_switch_state readers: cm848_selectTemperatureTrimValue, cm848_calculateWastegateDutyRequest, cm848_determineCurrentGearAndLockupInhibit, cm848_processOverdriveSwitchAndShift, mpc555_processColdStartMainLoop. The boost sensor fault test (faults 8 / 9 / 64 = P0238 / P0237 / P0236) belongs to the dead chain.

plate_comment: Turns the arbitrated retarder request into the retarder output: engine_retarder_request_percent takes engine_retarder_arbitrated_request_percent unless the shift hold flag freezes it. Below 50 percent it clears the engaged flag and logical output 11 (per engine_retarder_output_mode_flags bits 1 and 0); at 50 percent or more for engine_retarder_request_on_delay_passes passes it sets engine_retarder_engaged_flag and logical output 11, which is cleared again above engine_retarder_output_maximum_engine_speed when both mode bits are set, and while fault bit 101 is detected. Also saves the previous request percent and the wired switch percent copy (was cm848_processFuelEfficiencyTrim).
evidence: Read in full (58 lines) and disassembled the on-delay counter (0x3fb54c: lhz at 0x42074, sth at 0x4207c / 0x4212c, so word width). Step 7 (last) of the dispatcher; logical output 11 is the only output set by the cluster.

plate_comment: Runs the engine retarder request chain once per pass in order: cm848_updateEngineRetarderEnableState, cm848_limitEngineRetarderPercentToCruisePermission, cm848_limitEngineRetarderPercentToOperatorSelection, cm848_applyEngineRetarderTsc1Request, cm848_selectEngineRetarderRequest, cm848_updateEngineRetarderActiveState and cm848_driveEngineRetarderOutput (was cm848_processTimingDispatcher).
evidence: Seven calls, read in full; called from cm848_periodicTaskSet_sensorProcessing between cm848_processSpeedGovernorControl and cm848_calculateSpeedRateLimiting. Nothing in it is about timing.

evidence: Read in full (28 lines): five cm848_clearLogicalOutputRequest calls (11-15) and resets of every word the chain owns; called from the application init list next to initHpcr_ExceptionHandler.

plate_comment: Sets engine_retarder_cruise_permission_percent: 0 (no retarder braking) while cruise control is engaged (cruise_control_engaged_flag, with protection_config_flags_b bit 0x8000) and the filtered cruise_speed_setpoint_adjusted has not passed cruise_speed_command plus an offset (with hysteresis), or is at or below cruise_speed_min_threshold; otherwise 100. It is the cruise control limit, source code 2, of the retarder request (was governorOverrideSpeedControl).
evidence: Read in full (28 lines). Its only reader is governorLoadMinimumUpdate (engine_retarder_cruise_permission_percent), which records code 2 = ERC1 retarder torque mode 2 (cruise control). Which of cruise_speed_command / cruise_speed_setpoint_adjusted is the measured speed was not settled (many writers), so the plate does not say.

text: Mode 7 owner: cm848_initEngineOperatingMode (0x10110) holds the one literal assignment engine_operating_mode = 7 (other writers take the mode as a parameter), made only when engine_operating_mode == 0 and variable_speed_governor_selected_flag == 1 (that flag comes from variable_speed_governor_default_cal / cm848_updateVariableSpeedGovernorSelection), after cm848_blendGovernorTuningSets, so mode 7 is the variable speed governor selected by its flag. The block in cm848_runOperatingModeSpeedGovernor (.cpp lines 9128-9170) reduces governor_reference_speed_filtered: with the active flag set, above the upper threshold by the decay per call (or by upper minus lower when the decay is 0), otherwise by the lower step, then caps it at current rpm + governor_reference_speed_lead_offset + a manifold pressure gain and floors it at governor_reference_speed_floor; with the flag clear it sets the reference to the floor. The reason for the reduction (what the variable speed governor does with it) was not settled, so the rows below name only the verified mechanism. The fuel_trim_pid_* / fuel_trim_saved_* words (saved and restored PID state of the same loop, 0x40a20a-0x40a24a) and fuel_trim_speed_override_flag / fuel_trim_override_* were not renamed; 0x3ff6a2-0x3ff6a8 stay a [W3 rail] lead.

text: fuel_ema block: selectSensorRawChannels (0x1fa20, chooses one of the base / alternate / working coefficient sets into the selected set and records the set code in fuel_demand_state_code), cm848_processSystemStatusLimits (loads the working sets, set codes 0x14 / 0x15), cm848_initSensorRawChannels (selects the base set, code 0x10) and cm848_processTorqueLimitTiming (the consumer): a first-order filter (cm848_signedFirstOrderFilter on an error x fuel_demand_ema_gain_cal / 512, coefficient pointer = fuel_demand_ema_coeff_ptr -> coefficient 4, output fuel_demand_filtered_ema, accumulator injection_timing_compensation_int) whose output scales injection timing compensation terms: coefficient 1 -> injection_timing_scale_factor, 2 -> injection_timing_ema_coeff_computed, 3 -> injection_timing_compensation_scale, each optionally scheduled by |filtered output| through the coefficient N scale tables. The confirmed rows are the filter itself (coefficient 4, the coefficient pointer, input gain, output limits, output, snapshot) and the five injection_timing_compensation_* rows; the coefficient 1 to 3 rows are left uncertain with the planned scheme fuel_demand_filter_coefficient_<n>_<base|working|alternate|scaling_enable|scale_axis|scale_values|scale_cached_axis_offset>, which spells out coeff -> coefficient and ema -> filter and keeps the fuel demand vocabulary the wave-3 name fuel_demand_filter_coefficient_working_set_code already uses; whether fuel demand is the right domain is medium confidence. The accumulator word injection_timing_compensation_int (0x40a8d7) is reset together with fuel_demand_filtered_ema when the output leaves its limits, so it is the filter accumulator (misnamed), not renamed here.
